moli.reglages.cle_ok: OpenAI key saved (encrypted inside Moli). Roughly half a cent per exchange.
moli.reglages.cle_manque: To talk with Moli, it needs an OpenAI key (a few euros of credit last for months).
moli.reglages.etape1: Open {link} and create an account (or sign in).
moli.reglages.etape2: In {link}, add some credit: €5 covers hundreds of conversations.
moli.reglages.etape3: Recommended: set a monthly spending limit in {link} (for example €5).
moli.reglages.etape4: In {link}, click “Create new secret key”, name it “Moli”, then copy it (it starts with {code}).
moli.reglages.etape5: Paste it below: Moli checks it with OpenAI before keeping it.
moli.reglages.confidentialite: You’ll be asked for your code. The key is encrypted inside Moli and never shown again: to change it, replace it.
moli.reglages.aide_voix: Tap ▶ to listen, tap the name to pick it. If the online voice doesn’t answer, Moli speaks with its local voice.
moli.reglages.echantillon: Good evening! It’s twenty-two degrees in the living room. Anything I can help with?
moli.reglages.voix_muette: I can’t get this voice to speak.
